preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setFees_base1000 function
Contract must have tradingOpen = true (trading enabled)

exploit_hint: Call setFees_base1000 with all fee parameters set to zero, making totalFee = 0. This will cause division by zero in swapBack() function when totalETHFee = totalFee - burnFee (line 376) since burnFee is also zero, resulting in totalETHFee = 0. The division (swapThreshold * liquidityFee)/(totalETHFee * 2) will then revert due to division by zero, preventing fee distribution and potentially locking contract functionality.
